messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.19 released
parts:
Hi,

I released a new version of Nvim-R. I couldn't upload it to vim.org because it seems to exceed the new size limit for uploads. You can download it from https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/releases although I suggest the use of a plugin manager and then, you can choose the branch that best fits your needs:
https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/branches

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R 0.9.19 released
parts:
Hi,

That's because I don't know git commands very well. Instead of
"upgrading" the stable branch, I deleted it and created it again. So,
the branch histories are unrelated. I'm sorry for that. There is a
simple workaround: completely uninstall the plugin or delete the
directory and install or clone it again.

I hope this helps...

Best,

Jakson
